title: Score corroboration status — pure function mapping research findings to decision validity
acceptance_criteria: score_corroboration(findings, rationale) -> CorroborationReport is a pure function
Status determined: supported if >2 findings align with rationale, contradicted if >2 contradict, outdated if findings reference newer info, unverifiable otherwise
confidence_adjustment computed: positive boost for supported, negative for contradicted/outdated, zero for unverifiable
Evidence URLs extracted from findings with relevance_score > 0.5
All error paths raise domain exceptions, no bare except
